subject: AWS GTM intake / CloudCare Ops — registration & PDM/PSM alignment
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Li <sophie.li@amazon.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, ops@cloudcare.io
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS GTM intake / CloudCare Ops — registration & PDM/PSM alignment

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for taking the intro with CloudCare Ops last week. They are eager to move toward an ACE enrollment and co-sell plan but asked us to kick off the formal marketplace intake so AWS can pair the right PDM/PSM. Quick summary:

- Account: CloudCare Ops (ops@cloudcare.io)
- Opportunity: Native Redwood inference integration for in-product summarization and embeddings (initial pilot across 3 product teams)
- ARR estimate: $210k first 12 months (pilot -> expansion motion)
- Technical notes: customer runs multi-tenant SaaS on EKS/ECR; requires private VPC integration for Dedicated footprints and SOC2 evidence for procurement.

I attached a filled ACE intake form and a short opportunity summary to speed review. Could you confirm the PDM/PSM pairing and next steps on your side (intake acceptance, calendar for a mutual action plan, and any additional intake artifacts AWS needs)?

Proposed times for a short alignment call (30m): Thu 8/6 10–11am PT or Fri 8/7 8–10am PT.

Appreciate the help — I’ll loop in Karthik and Jonas on next actions.

Best,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Manager, Cloud Partners
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ace-intake-form.pdf (PDF, 62KB)]
[Attachment: cloudcare-opportunity-summary.md (MD, 6KB)]

Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 12:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: AWS GTM intake / CloudCare Ops — registration & PDM/PSM alignment

Hi Mina —

Thanks for the detailed intake — I submitted the ACE registration on CloudCare’s behalf and copied the intake ID into the subject of the internal ticket. Welcome to the co-sell process. I’m introducing Rajesh (PDM) and Emily (PSM) from the AWS side so they can own pairing and run the readiness checks:

- Rajesh Narayan <rajesh.narayan@amazon.com> (PDM)
- Emily Tan <emily.tan@amazon.com> (PSM)

Rajesh/Emily — Mina has shared a short opportunity brief and the ACE intake form attached. The ask from CloudCare is marketplace enrollment and support for a Dedicated deployment pilot tied to an initial ARR estimate. Can you confirm the intake is complete from AWS’s perspective and whether you need any additional materials (security docs, architecture diagram, PO/contract templates) to advance to ACE approval?

Mina — I scheduled a tentative 30m sync for Thu 8/6 10:30am PT on behalf of the group; please accept if that works.

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Li
Partner Sales, AWS Marketplace
[Note: ACE intake submitted — internal ticket #AWS-ACE-44321]

Subject: Re: AWS GTM intake / CloudCare Ops — registration & PDM/PSM alignment

Thanks Sophie — Rajesh/Emily, great to meet you.

A few quick artifacts to help intake review are attached: our updated co-sell deck (high-level architecture, integration patterns, security posture) plus the customer summary again. Key points to highlight for AWS intake:

- Pilot scope: 3 product teams, ~150k monthly inference tokens during pilot
- Preferred deployment: Redwood Dedicated in a VPC peered with CloudCare’s EKS cluster; fall back to hosted API for non-sensitive datasets
- Security posture: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in progress; we can provide the SOC report and architecture one-pager if needed (link below).
- Commercial ask: initial pilots billed monthly; we expect to convert to a committed Dedicated seat after pilot if performance targets met.

I’ve proposed the MA P for Thu 8/6 10:30am PT — Karthik and Jonas will cover commercial and technical follow-ups on our side.

Thanks —
Mina
[Attachment: redwood-cloudcare-deck-v2.pdf (PDF, 3.1MB)]
[Attachment: pricing-summary.xlsx (XLSX, 44KB)]

Thanks for the intake and materials. I’m Rajesh (PDM) — glad to partner. I’ll run the ACE intake through the internal readiness checklist and aim to get a decision on enrollment next week. Rajesh
